authority: ENG self-review of the open capability gaps registered by the supervisor's rulings (#K2-361/362/370/375). The supervisor decides closures; this artifact states, per gap, the ASSET and the REGRESSION in the repo and the ENG's recommendation.
method: for each gap: asset file(s) in the repo + the regression that would prove it (test name, all inside `eda_eng selftest` = 66/66 PASS) + the evidence pointer. A gap is recommended CLOSED only when asset AND regression both exist and pass.

gaps.title: claim != artifact (a claim must never outrun the produced artifact)
asset: tools/k2_delivery_closure_check_v1.py (the four-piece delivery closure: k2 commit / k2 pushed / parent pointer / parent pushed)
tools/eda_eng/verify.py (the judge never returns PASS for a skipped criterion)
the R964 process rule: a gate must NEVER be piped through tee inside an && chain (per-window discipline)
gaps.regression: test_C30_product_chain_runs_M1_to_M4_with_call_chain_evidence (a chain that cannot reach M4 must stop with a NAMED result)
gaps.recommendation: KEEP OPEN - the family is broad (it also covers per-window claim/artifact matching, which is a discipline rather than a unit test); the asset is in daily use, but there is no single machine check for 'every claim in a receipt has an artifact'.
gaps.evidence: closure check PASS every window; R964 corrective commit

gaps.title: chain-segment behavioural premises machine-checked (the premises a chain stage assumes)
asset: every new-capability chain now emits per-stage call-chain evidence with cmd/exit (regen.relocate_block_chain / relocate_relative_chain)
regen.mech_probe / mech_probe_moves (baseline-relative mechanical probe as a premise check)
gaps.recommendation: KEEP OPEN - the chain-of-custody evidence exists, but the PREMISES each stage relies on are still checked in prose rather than by a gate.

gaps.title: in-register RULE intent <-> form binding (the purpose of a rule is not machine-linked to its written form)
gaps.recommendation: KEEP OPEN - untouched by the BLOCK/A-prime work; the H4 x-order rule case remains the example. This is a separate work item (a rule_id -> purpose -> binding_test registry).
gaps.evidence: #K2-355 sec.2.3 (the ruling that named the gap)

gaps.title: the product call chain was not machine-checked (unit-green != product-green)
asset: exam A --run --chain product executes the BLOCK chain (M0 -> M1 -> M2 -> M3 -> step5 -> M4) and emits the named stages as call-chain evidence
regen.c17v1_argv / relocate_relative_c17v1 (the product path: the chain hands the per-part map to the in-repo product)
gaps.recommendation: CLOSE (asset + regression PASS) - the chain's stages are asserted by a test and the product path is wired with its own argv regression.

gaps.title: via prism: the layer change only checked the two endpoint layers
asset: route.maze_route: a layer change now checks EVERY layer in the via span
gaps.regression: test_K369_maze_via_prism_checks_every_layer_in_span (In1.Cu fully walled => BLOCKED; without In1.Cu in the stack => ROUTED)
gaps.recommendation: CLOSE (asset + regression PASS) - the defect is fixed and locked by a discriminating regression.

gaps.title: the BLOCK chain did not support a PER-PART displacement map
asset: block.move_parts (per-part offsets; in-block copper re-laid; outside halves kept as fixed dR ports)
regen.relocate_relative_chain + CLI relocate-relative; block.clip_iu (IU-exact cut); block.moves_from_board (gate-board alignment)
gaps.recommendation: KEEP OPEN - the mechanism is built and regression-covered at the unit level, but the closing criterion is the functional one: C1-C9 must PASS under the per-part map (currently FAIL: C1 40 / C2 564).

gaps.title: a new-capability window had no sec.20 prerequisite gate (it relied on memory)
asset: CLI door: `relocate-relative` REFUSES with exit 2 / REFUSED_BY_SEC20_GATE before any board work when the ledger lacks the sec.20 entry
gaps.recommendation: CLOSE (asset + regression PASS) - the enforcement is at the command door, which is exactly the 'gate hits before the window opens' criterion.

summary.note: M-ENG-ROUTER-REROUTE (primary critical path) stays in progress; its closing criterion is unchanged: exam A-prime AND exam B both PASS.
